prompt:
You are a business manager at an online marketplace in Brazil. Customers buy products from many independent sellers. The company has data on orders, products and product categories, customers and the Brazilian states they live in, sellers, payments (payment methods and installments), deliveries (delivery dates and estimated dates) and customer reviews, from September 2016 to October 2018.

Write 25 different questions you would ask your data analyst. Use your own natural business wording. Mix simple and harder questions, and cover different topics. Write one question per line, numbered, with nothing else.
